Whether you’re using Galaxy Buds4 or Galaxy Buds4 Pro, learn how to insert them correctly and get the most out of your audio. Discover the right blade angle for clear voice pickup and how to choose the best ear tip size (S, M, or L) for a secure, comfortable fit—even on the move. Learn more: http://smsng.co/Buds4Series_BestFit_yt

Follow these steps to get the right fit with Galaxy Buds4 Series:

Wearing the earbuds 
Step 1: Lift the earbuds straight up from the charging case. 
Step 2: Check the L/R marks and place them in the matching ear. 
Step 3: Point the blade toward your mouth and rotate slightly until snug. 
Step 4: Listen for the sound feedback to confirm they are in the right position.

description:
Lost your Galaxy Buds4 Series? Locate them in seconds using the SmartThings app. This official guide shows you how to quickly track and find your earbuds right from your smartphone.

Learn how to use real-time tracking and audible alerts to pinpoint their location, so you can spend less time searching and more time listening. Stay connected and in control with Galaxy Buds4 or Galaxy Buds4 Pro, and find them whenever you need. Learn more: http://smsng.co/GalaxyBuds4_SmartThings_yt

00:00 Intro
00:17 SmartThings setup
00:51 Earbud location tracking

SmartThings setup
Step 1: Download the SmartThings app from the Samsung Galaxy Store.
Step 2: Ensure your Galaxy Buds4 Series is registered to your account.
Step 3: Tap 'Find' in the app to view your device.

Tracking your earbuds
Step 1: Open the charging case.
Step 2: View the map to see the current or last known location.
Step 3: Select 'Ring' to make your earbuds play a sound.
Step 4: Follow the sound to recover your device.
